Subject: Implementation of CCPAP Module for Payment- Obtaining
Digital Signature.
Ref. Circular of even no. dated 28.04.2014 (SI. No. 59 on EPFO’s Website)

Sir/Madam,
Kindly refer to the above said subject.

2. The transaction under CCPAP will be routed through SFTP (Secured
File Transferred Protocol) server of SBI to maintain security of data and to reduce
operational risk by securing the transmission route. Therefore, the file shall be
digitally signed to prevent tampering of data before uploading of the file by EPFO.

3. All RPFCs are requested to obtain Class-2 Digital Signature
Certificate from the nearest centre of NIC no later than 31.05.2014 to enable the
implementation of the above said module as per schedule.

4. The Regional Offices may submit a compliance report by the said
date.
5. This has approval of Central Provident Fund Commissioner.

Yours faithfully

(Sanjay Hiker)
